hook: Li made modern AI's breakthrough possible by betting on data before it was fashionable: ImageNet's fourteen million labeled images gave the field the benchmark on which AlexNet proved deep learning worked. She has spent the years since insisting the technology stay pointed at people, building Stanford HAI and carrying the human-centered case into policy rooms from Sacramento to Washington.
name: Fei-Fei Li

quote.text: There's nothing artificial about AI. It's inspired by people, it's created by people, and, most importantly, it impacts people.
quote.context: A theme of her public talks and writing, stated in her 2018 U.S. House testimony

primary.name: ImageNet: A large-scale hierarchical image database, CVPR 2009
The Worlds I See, Fei-Fei Li (2023)

secondary.name: Fei-Fei Li testimony, U.S. House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology (June 26, 2018)

timeline.impact: Deep learning validated on her benchmark

timeline.event: Chief Scientist, Google Cloud AI; founds AI4ALL

timeline.impact: The field's origin story, told from inside
Spatial intelligence as the next bet

quick_facts: Created ImageNet, the dataset that made the deep-learning revolution measurable and possible
Co-founded Stanford's Institute for Human-Centered AI (HAI) and the nonprofit AI4ALL
Former Chief Scientist of AI/ML at Google Cloud; memoir The Worlds I See (2023)
Co-founded World Labs (2024) to build spatial intelligence

achievements.title: ImageNet (2009) and the ImageNet Challenge (2010-2017)
achievements.impact: The dataset and competition that produced the 2012 deep-learning breakthrough and a decade of measured progress.

achievements.title: Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI (2019, co-founded with John Etchemendy)
achievements.impact: The leading academic institution arguing AI should augment rather than replace human capability, with direct lines into U.S. policy.

achievements.title: AI4ALL (2017)
achievements.impact: National nonprofit opening AI education to underrepresented students, addressing who builds the field.

achievements.title: The Worlds I See (2023) and World Labs (2024)
achievements.impact: The memoir put a human story at AI's center; the startup pursues spatial intelligence as the next frontier.
